featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating:  1/5 — Very Disappointing Experience
Dissatisfied Experience: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
​I am writing this to warn every potential customer in Mulund: before stepping  into Swarnaprabha Jewellers.According to me  This shop is running a systematic tactic involving under-purity gold, predatory sales tactics, and unethical payment demands.
​1. The "100% Payment" Trap & Poor Craftsmanship
I paid a 60% advance, but when the jewelry was finally shown to me after 20 days, it was full of mistakes and not at all what I ordered. Instead of fixing their errors, the owner demanded the remaining 40% payment immediately before any corrections were made. When I refused to pay for a defective product, the owner turned rude, blaming me for "pending payments" while his own craftsmen took months to do simple fixes. He literally told me to "close the deal and take it as it is." No professional jeweler asks for full payment before the customer is satisfied with the design.
​2. Purity Concerns (The 916/22k )
I purchased jewelry sold and hallmarked as 22k (916). However, my independent touch report proved it was only 20k to 21k. When confronted, the salesman, Devendra, had the audacity to suggest I "melt the gold" so he could buy it back. Why would any customer pay making charges for new jewelry just to be told to melt it? It is a complete joke and a total loss for the buyer.
​3. Predatory Salesman (Devendra)
Devendra is extremely greedy for profits and treats customers like beggars once the money is paid. He constantly pushes "melting advice" while buying old gold to provide less value. He is only interested in playing with you out of your old gold assets.
​4. Quality & Pricing Red Flags
​Overcharging: Their rates are ₹5,000–₹6,000 higher than the entire Mulund market. They charge for 997 purity but provide 90-solder gold in return.
​Fragile Jewelry: The new jewelry I purchased breaks repeatedly. The quality is pathetic.
​Fear of Law: Once they realized that they are caught in  their purity concern, they suddenly started bargaining on making charges because they are terrified of legal action
​5. Rude Management
The owner is incredibly rude and has zero business sense. He is entirely dependent on his staff, who are openly  confusing customers. He refuses to take responsibility for incorrect designs and claims "correction costs are too high" to avoid fixing his own mistakes.
​This shop is a den of in lack of transparency.Purity test result i received was different from what was claimed. Save your hard-earned money and go to an honest, reputed jeweler. Based on my experience customer should carefully verify details before purchasing I am not satisfied with behavior of staff and the sales approach felt very uncomfortable

After Few days of posting this review this Jeweller is sending me notices of lawyer and asking me to delete this reality of this review and hide his reality in public.
